records.traditional: 他是新同學。
records.pinyin: Tā shì xīn tóngxué.
records.english: He is the new classmate.

records.traditional: 她是誰？
records.pinyin: Tā shì shéi?
records.english: Who is she?

records.traditional: 我叫王宜文。
records.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Wáng Yíwén.
records.english: My name is Wang Yiwen.

records.traditional: 我姓王，叫宜文。
records.pinyin: Wǒ xìng Wáng, jiào Yíwén.
records.english: My surname is Wang. My first name is Yiwen.

records.traditional: 新同學很可愛。
records.pinyin: Xīn tóngxué hěn kěài.
records.english: The new classmate is lovely.

records.traditional: 他是哪國人？
records.pinyin: Tā shì nǎ guó rén?
records.english: Which country is he from?

records.sourceMeaning: sentence-final particle for a "Yes / No" question
records.traditional: 他是誰？妳知道嗎？
records.pinyin: Tā shì shéi? Nǐ zhīdào ma?
records.english: Who is he? Do you know?

records.traditional: A：他是哪國人？ B：他是美國人。
records.pinyin: A: Tā shì nǎ guó rén? B: Tā shì Měiguó rén.
records.english: A: Which country is he from? B: He is American.

records.traditional: 她很漂亮。
records.pinyin: Tā hěn piàoliàng.
records.english: She is very pretty.

records.traditional: 他叫什麼名字？你知道嗎？
records.pinyin: Tā jiào shénme míngzi? Nǐ zhīdào ma?
records.english: What is his name? Do you know?

records.sourceMeaning: sentence-final particle for a "how about" question
records.traditional: 我是臺灣人，你呢？
records.pinyin: Wǒ shì Táiwān rén, nǐ ne?
records.english: I am Taiwanese. How about you?

records.traditional: A：你喜歡臺灣嗎？ B：我喜歡臺灣。
records.pinyin: A: Nǐ xǐhuān Táiwān ma? B: Wǒ xǐhuān Táiwān.
records.english: A: Do you like Taiwan? B: I like Taiwan.

records.traditional: A：你好嗎？ B：我很好。
records.pinyin: A: Nǐ hǎo ma? B: Wǒ hěn hǎo.
records.english: A: How are you? B: I am good.

records.traditional: 請問你是臺灣人嗎？
records.pinyin: Qǐngwèn nǐ shì Táiwān rén ma?
records.english: Excuse me, are you Taiwanese?

records.traditional: 大家好，我是小林友美。
records.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, wǒ shì Xiǎolín Yǒuměi.
records.english: Hi, everyone. I am Xiaolin Youmei.

records.traditional: 我愛你。
records.pinyin: Wǒ ài nǐ.
records.english: I love you.

records.traditional: 我愛吃水果。
records.pinyin: Wǒ ài chī shuǐguǒ.
records.english: I love eating fruit.

records.traditional: 我喜歡喝茶。
records.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān hē chá.
records.english: I like to drink tea.

records.traditional: A：謝謝你。 B：不客氣。
records.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ. B: Bú kèqi.
records.english: A: Thank you. B: You are welcome.

records.traditional: 現在幾點鐘？
records.pinyin: Xiànzài jǐ diǎnzhōng?
records.english: What time is it now?

records.traditional: 你幾點去學校？
records.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn qù xuéxiào?
records.english: What time do you go to school?

records.traditional: 今天是五月十七日，星期一。
records.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǔ yuè shíqī rì, xīngqí yī.
records.english: Today is Monday, May 17th.

records.traditional: A：你今天早上有課嗎？ B：我今天早上沒有課。
records.pinyin: A: Nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang yǒu kè ma? B: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang méi yǒu kè.
records.english: A: Do you have class this morning? B: I don’t have class this morning.

records.traditional: 你幾點去圖書館？
records.pinyin: Nǐ jǐdiǎn qù túshūguǎn?
records.english: What time will you go to the library?

records.traditional: 你中午回家嗎？
records.pinyin: Nǐ zhōngwǔ huí jiā ma?
records.english: Do you go home at noon?

records.traditional: 我八點十分去學校。
records.pinyin: Wǒ bā diǎn shí fēn qù xuéxiào.
records.english: I go to school at 8:10.

records.traditional: A：現在幾點？ B：現在十點二十五分。
records.pinyin: A: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? B: Xiànzài shí diǎn èrshíwǔ fēn.
records.english: A: What time is it now? B: It’s 10:25.

records.traditional: 你昨天幾點回家？
records.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān jǐ diǎn huí jiā?
records.english: What time did you go home yesterday?

records.sourceMeaning: to want to verb/ do something
records.traditional: 你要水嗎？
records.pinyin: Nǐ yào shuǐ ma?
records.english: Do you want water?

records.sourceMeaning: to want to verb/ do something
records.traditional: 我要喝珍珠奶茶。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yào hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.
records.english: I want to have bubble milk tea.

records.traditional: 他今天不來學校嗎？
records.pinyin: Tā jīntiān bù lái xuéxiào ma?
records.english: Isn’t he coming to school today?

records.traditional: 啊！今天是你的生日。生日快樂！
records.pinyin: Ā! Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì. Shēngrì kuàilè!
records.english: Ah! It is your birthday today. Happy birthday!

records.traditional: 老師：你們有問題嗎？ 學生：沒有。謝謝老師。
records.pinyin: Lǎoshī: Nǐmen yǒu wèntí ma? Xuéshēng: Méi yǒu. Xièxie lǎoshī.
records.english: Teacher: Do you have any questions? Student: No. Thank you, teacher.

records.traditional: 你今天要做什麼？
records.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān yào zuò shénme?
records.english: What do you want to do today?

records.traditional: 我爸爸五十歲，我媽媽四十八歲。
records.pinyin: Wǒ bàba wǔshí suì, wǒ māma sìshíbā suì.
records.english: My father is fifty years old and my mother is forty-eight years old.

records.traditional: 我今天七點起床。
records.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
records.english: I get up at 7:00 today.

records.traditional: 我很喜歡做飯。
records.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zuòfàn.
records.english: I like cooking very much.

records.sourceMeaning: to sleep; to go to bed
records.traditional: 宜文昨天幾點睡覺？
records.pinyin: Yíwén zuótiān jǐ diǎn shuìjiào?
records.english: What time did Yiwen go to sleep yesterday?

records.traditional: 媽媽忙不忙？
records.pinyin: Māma máng bù máng?
records.english: Is Mom busy?

records.traditional: 中明今天很累。
records.pinyin: Zhōngmíng jīntiān hěn lèi.
records.english: Zhongming is very tired today.

records.traditional: 你今天要買什麼？
records.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān yào mǎi shénme?
records.english: What would you like to buy today?

records.traditional: 我要去買禮物。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù mǎi lǐwù.
records.english: I am going to buy gifts.

records.sourceMeaning: to want to; would like to
records.traditional: 我想喝珍珠奶茶。
records.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.
records.english: I want to have bubble milk tea.

records.traditional: 明天是媽媽的生日，你想送她什麼禮物？
records.pinyin: Míngtiān shì māma de shēngrì, nǐ xiǎng sòng tā shénme lǐwù?
records.english: Tomorrow is mom’s birthday, what do you want to give her as a gift?

records.traditional: 我有一個英國朋友。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge Yīngguó péngyǒu.
records.english: I have a British friend.

records.traditional: 他很喜歡看書。
records.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān kànshū.
records.english: He likes reading books very much.

records.traditional: 我想買兩本中文書、一本英文書。
records.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng běn Zhōngwén shū, yì běn Yīngwén shū.
records.english: I want to buy two books in Chinese and a book in English.

records.traditional: 我有一些中文書。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yìxiē Zhōngwén shū.
records.english: I have some books in Chinese.

records.traditional: 我送媽媽一朵花。
records.pinyin: Wǒ sòng māma yì duǒ huā.
records.english: I gave mom a flower.

records.traditional: 他送我花和一本書。
records.pinyin: Tā sòng wǒ huā hé yì běn shū.
records.english: He gave me flowers and a book as presents.

records.traditional: 我要買大蛋糕，不要買小蛋糕。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi dà dàngāo, bú yào mǎi xiǎo dàngāo.
records.english: I want to buy a big cake, not a small one.

records.traditional: 我要買蛋。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi dàn.
records.english: I want to buy eggs.

records.traditional: 昨天我們一起去圖書館。
records.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen yìqǐ qù túshūguǎn.
records.english: We went to the library together yesterday.

records.traditional: 好啊，我們一起吃蛋糕。
records.pinyin: Hǎo ā, wǒmen yìqǐ chī dàngāo.
records.english: Great, let’s eat the cake together.

records.traditional: 我要買這本書，不要買那本書。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi zhè běn shū, bú yào mǎi nà běn shū.
records.english: I want to buy this book, not that one.

records.traditional: 你喜歡喝哪種茶？
records.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān hē nǎ zhǒng chá?
records.english: What kind of tea do you like?

records.traditional: A：你要哪種筆？ B：我要鉛筆。
records.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào nǎ zhǒng bǐ? B: Wǒ yào qiānbǐ.
records.english: A: What kind of pen do you want? B: I want a pencil.

records.traditional: 台灣的珍珠奶茶怎麼樣？
records.pinyin: Táiwān de zhēnzhū nǎichá zěnmeyàng?
records.english: How about Taiwan’s bubble milk tea?

records.traditional: 你要買什麼東西？
records.pinyin: Nǐ yào mǎi shénme dōngxi?
records.english: What stuff are you going to buy?

records.traditional: 我有兩枝鉛筆。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī qiānbǐ.
records.english: I have two pencils.

records.traditional: 一枝筆幾塊錢？
records.pinyin: Yì zhī bǐ jǐ kuài qián?
records.english: How much is a pen?

records.traditional: 這本書八十元。
records.pinyin: Zhè běn shū bāshí yuán.
records.english: This book costs eighty dollars.

records.traditional: A：這種蛋糕很貴嗎？ B：是啊，這種蛋糕不便宜。
records.pinyin: A: Zhè zhǒng dàngāo hěn guì ma? B: Shì ā, zhè zhǒng dàngāo bù piányí.
records.english: A: Is this kind of cake expensive? B: Yes, this kind of cake is not cheap.

records.traditional: 你喜歡什麼顏色？
records.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān shénme yánsè?
records.english: What color do you like?

records.traditional: A：你喜歡紅色的筆嗎？ B：我喜歡白的。
records.pinyin: A: Nǐ xǐhuān hóngsè de bǐ ma? B: Wǒ xǐhuān bái de.
records.english: A: Do you like red pens? B: I like white pens.

records.traditional: 紅色的花、白色的花都很漂亮。
records.pinyin: Hóngsè de huā, báisè de huā, dōu hěn piàoliang.
records.english: Red and white flowers are both beautiful.

records.traditional: 這朵花很好看。
records.pinyin: Zhè duǒ huā hěn hǎokàn.
records.english: This flower is beautiful.

records.traditional: 那個學生很好看。
records.pinyin: Nà ge xuéshēng hěn hǎokàn.
records.english: The student is very good-looking.

records.traditional: 我們常常一起去圖書館。
records.pinyin: Wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ qù túshūguǎn.
records.english: We often go to the library together.

records.traditional: 這件衣服的顏色很漂亮。
records.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de yánsè hěn piàoliang.
records.english: The color of this clothing is very pretty.

records.traditional: 他請我去他家玩。
records.pinyin: Tā qǐng wǒ qù tā jiā wán.
records.english: He invited me to his place.

records.traditional: 我請他喝台灣茶。
records.pinyin: Wǒ qǐng tā hē Táiwān chá.
records.english: I treated him with Taiwan tea.

records.traditional: 我今天晚上要去同學家玩。
records.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān wǎnshang yào qù tóngxué jiā wán.
records.english: I am going to hang out with my classmate at his/her place tonight.

records.traditional: 這些是中文書，那些是英文書。
records.pinyin: Zhèxiē shì Zhōngwén shū, nàxiē shì Yīngwén shū.
records.english: These are books in Chinese; those are in English.

records.traditional: 甜的點心叫甜點。
records.pinyin: Tián de diǎnxīn jiào tiándiǎn.
records.english: Sweet snacks are called dessert.

records.traditional: 他今天很開心。
records.pinyin: Tā jīntiān hěn kāixīn.
records.english: He is very happy today.

records.traditional: 你要喝什麼？咖啡還是茶？
records.pinyin: Nǐ yào hē shénme? Kāfēi háishì chá?
records.english: What do you want to drink? Coffee or tea?

records.traditional: 今天天氣好熱。
records.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hǎo rè.
records.english: The weather is so hot today.

records.traditional: 我很忙，也很累。
records.pinyin: Wǒ hěn máng, yě hěn lèi.
records.english: I’m very busy and tired as well.

records.traditional: 現在我不渴，我很餓。
records.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ bù kě, wǒ hěn è.
records.english: I am not thirsty now, I am really hungry.

records.traditional: 我想喝一點兒飲料。
records.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hē yìdiǎnr yǐnliào.
records.english: I would like to have a little drink.

records.traditional: 你想去哪家餐廳？
records.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ jiā cāntīng?
records.english: Which restaurant do you like to go to?

records.traditional: 天氣太熱，我要喝飲料。
records.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè, wǒ yào hē yǐnliào.
records.english: The weather is too hot, I want some beverage.

records.traditional: 我的中文書很多，你要不要看？
records.pinyin: Wǒ de Zhōngwén shū hěn duō, nǐ yào bú yào kàn?
records.english: I have many Chinese books, would you like to read?

records.traditional: 我爸爸喜歡吃飯，我媽媽喜歡吃麵。
records.pinyin: Wǒ bàba xǐhuān chī fàn, wǒ māma xǐhuān chī miàn.
records.english: My dad likes to eat rice, my mom likes to eat noodles.

records.traditional: 這家餐廳的甜點很好吃。
records.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de tiándiǎn hěn hǎochī.
records.english: This restaurant has delicious desserts.

records.traditional: 這種飲料很好喝。
records.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yǐnliào hěn hǎohē.
records.english: This kind of beverage tastes good.

records.sourceMeaning: used after a Vs, preceded by 太
records.traditional: 我太累了，不想去玩。
records.pinyin: Wǒ tài lèi le, bù xiǎng qù wán.
records.english: I am so tired! I do not want to hang out.

records.traditional: 我爸爸、媽媽有三個孩子，我最愛看書。
records.pinyin: Wǒ bàba, māma yǒu sān ge háizi, wǒ zuì ài kànshū.
records.english: My parents have three kids. I like to read the most.

records.traditional: 這家餐廳賣飲料嗎？
records.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng mài yǐnliào ma?
records.english: Does this restaurant sell beverage?

records.traditional: A：你想點什麼？ B：我想點一碗牛肉麵。
records.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiǎng diǎn shénme? B: Wǒ xiǎng diǎn yì wǎn niúròu miàn.
records.english: A: What would you like to order? B: I want to order a bowl of beef noodles.

records.traditional: 我要一杯珍珠奶茶。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá.
records.english: I would like to have a cup of bubble milk tea.

records.traditional: 你很渴嗎？我有一瓶飲料，你要不要喝？
records.pinyin: Nǐ hěn kě ma? Wǒ yǒu yì píng yǐnliào, nǐ yào bú yào hē?
records.english: Are you thirsty? I have a bottle of beverage, would you like to have some?

records.traditional: 我的女朋友很喜歡喝珍珠奶茶。
records.pinyin: Wǒ de nǚ péngyǒu hěn xǐhuān hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.
records.english: My girlfriend likes bubble milk tea very much.

records.traditional: 我有一位英國老師和兩位日本老師。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí wèi Yīngguó lǎoshī hé liǎng wèi Rìběn lǎoshī.
records.english: I have one British teacher and two Japanese teachers.

records.traditional: 請給我一杯綠茶。
records.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi lǜchá.
records.english: Please give me a cup of green tea.

records.traditional: 這些東西一共多少錢？
records.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng duōshǎo qián?
records.english: How much do these things cost altogether?

records.traditional: 這些東西一共兩萬三千五百零五塊。
records.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng liǎng wàn sān qiān wǔ bǎi líng wǔ kuài.
records.english: These stuff cost twenty three thousand, five hundred and five dollars in total.

records.traditional: 他找你多少錢？
records.pinyin: Tā zhǎo nǐ duōshǎo qián?
records.english: How much change did he give you?

records.traditional: 這個杯子一百多塊錢。
records.pinyin: Zhè ge bēizi yì bǎi duō kuài qián.
records.english: This cup is over a hundred dollars.

records.traditional: 秋天的天氣最好，不冷也不熱。
records.pinyin: Qiūtiān de tiānqì zuì hǎo, bù lěng yě bú rè.
records.english: The weather is the best in autumn, not too cold and not too hot.

records.traditional: 台灣夏天的天氣很熱，很多人都喜歡喝飲料。
records.simplified: 台湾夏天的天气很热，很多人都喜欢喝饮料。
records.pinyin: Táiwān xiàtiān de tiānqì hěn rè, hěn duō rén dōu xǐhuān hē yǐnliào.
records.english: During summer the weather is very hot in Taiwan, many people like to have beverages.

records.traditional: 這家商店的東西很便宜。
records.pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn de dōngxi hěn piányi.
records.english: Stuff in this store is quite cheap.

records.traditional: 你要果汁還是牛奶？
records.pinyin: Nǐ yào guǒzhī háishì niúnǎi?
records.english: Do you want juice or milk?

records.traditional: 這些水果，有的不甜，我不想吃。
records.pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ, yǒude bù tián, wǒ bù xiǎng chī.
records.english: Some of this fruit are not sweet, I do not want to eat them.

records.traditional: 我每個星期都有中文課。
records.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge xīngqí dōu yǒu Zhōngwén kè.
records.english: I have Chinese class every week.

records.traditional: 我爸爸每天早上都喝一杯咖啡。
records.pinyin: Wǒ bàba měi tiān zǎoshang dōu hē yì bēi kāfēi.
records.english: My father drinks a cup of coffee every morning.

records.traditional: 李小姐的錢包是紅色的。
records.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě de qiánbāo shì hóngsè de.
records.english: Miss Li’s purse is red.

records.traditional: 他在學校，不在家。
records.pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào, bú zài jiā.
records.english: He is at school, not at home.

records.traditional: 我在家看書。
records.pinyin: Wǒ zài jiā kànshū.
records.english: I am reading at home.

records.traditional: 我的錢包在哪裡？
records.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo zài nǎlǐ?
records.english: Where is my wallet?

records.traditional: 我喜歡聽音樂。
records.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān tīng yīnyuè.
records.english: I like to listen to music.

records.traditional: 這本書很不錯。
records.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn búcuò.
records.english: This book is not bad.

records.traditional: 我喜歡去咖啡廳看書。
records.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān qù kāfēitīng kànshū.
records.english: I like to read at a café.

records.traditional: 那家飲料店的飲料很好喝，我們去那裡買。
records.pinyin: Nà jiā yǐnliào diàn de yǐnliào hěn hǎohē, wǒmen qù nàlǐ mǎi.
records.english: That beverage store serves great beverages. Let’s go there and get some.

records.traditional: 我在學校，你要來這裡嗎？
records.pinyin: Wǒ zài xuéxiào, nǐ yào lái zhèlǐ ma?
records.english: I am at the school. Do you want to come here? (Are you coming?)

records.traditional: 我和朋友常常一起去吃冰淇淋。
records.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu chángcháng yìqǐ qù chī bīngqílín.
records.english: My friends and I often go have ice cream together.

records.traditional: 我很喜歡這家店的巧克力蛋糕。
records.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zhè jiā diàn de qiǎokèlì dàngāo.
records.english: I like the chocolate cake from this shop.

records.traditional: 現在十二點半。
records.pinyin: Xiànzài shí'èr diǎn bàn.
records.english: It is half past twelve.

records.traditional: 這枝筆太貴了，你買便宜的吧。
records.pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ tài guì le, nǐ mǎi piányi de ba.
records.english: This pen is too expensive, you had better buy a cheaper one.

records.traditional: 你週末有空嗎？
records.pinyin: Nǐ zhōumò yǒukòng ma?
records.english: Are you available this weekend?

records.traditional: 這個蛋糕跟這瓶果汁一共多少錢？
records.pinyin: Zhè ge dàngāo gēn zhè píng guǒzhī yígòng duōshǎo qián?
records.english: How much do this cake and this bottle of juice cost?

records.traditional: 我想去朋友家玩，可是沒有空。
records.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù péngyǒu jiā wán, kěshì méi yǒukòng.
records.english: I would like to go to my friend’s place, but I don’t have time.

records.traditional: 我的房間不太大。
records.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān bú tài dà.
records.english: My room is not so big.

records.traditional: 這棟房子不大，可是很貴。
records.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi bú dà, kěshì hěn guì.
records.english: This is not a big house, but very expensive.

records.traditional: 你的書在房間裡。
records.pinyin: Nǐ de shū zài fángjiān lǐ.
records.english: Your book is in the room.

records.traditional: 他在房間外面做什麼？
records.pinyin: Tā zài fángjiān wàimiàn zuò shénme?
records.english: What is he doing outside of the room?

records.traditional: 爸爸在客廳喝咖啡。
records.pinyin: Bàba zài kètīng hē kāfēi.
records.english: Dad is drinking coffee in the living room.

records.sourceMeaning: measure word for tables and chairs
records.traditional: 我要買一張桌子跟四張椅子。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng zhuōzi gēn sì zhāng yǐzi.
records.english: I want to buy one table and four chairs.

records.sourceMeaning: above; over; on top of; on the surface of
records.traditional: 你的筆在那本書上面。
records.pinyin: Nǐ de bǐ zài nà běn shū shàngmiàn.
records.english: Your pen is on top of the book.

records.traditional: 你的房間裡有幾張椅子？
records.pinyin: Nǐ de fángjiān lǐ yǒu jǐ zhāng yǐzi?
records.english: How many chairs are there in your room?

records.traditional: 我媽媽有一個哥哥跟兩個妹妹。
records.pinyin: Wǒ māma yǒu yí ge gēge gēn liǎng ge mèimei.
records.english: My mom has an elder brother and two younger sisters.

records.traditional: 客廳裡面有兩張沙發。
records.pinyin: Kètīng lǐmiàn yǒu liǎng zhāng shāfā.
records.english: There are two sofas in the living room.

records.traditional: 你的錢包在那件衣服下面。
records.pinyin: Nǐ de qiánbāo zài nà jiàn yīfu xiàmiàn.
records.english: Your wallet is under that piece of clothing.

records.traditional: 我旁邊有日本同學，前面跟後面都有美國同學。
records.pinyin: Wǒ pángbiān yǒu Rìběn tóngxué, qiánmiàn gēn hòumiàn dōu yǒu Měiguó tóngxué.
records.english: There are Japanese classmates beside me, and there are American classmates in front and behind.

records.traditional: 他常常幫朋友，是一個好人。
records.pinyin: Tā chángcháng bāng péngyǒu, shì yí ge hǎo rén.
records.english: He helps his friends often. He is a nice guy.

records.traditional: 你要找什麼？我幫你找。
records.pinyin: Nǐ yào zhǎo shénme? Wǒ bāng nǐ zhǎo.
records.english: What do you want to look for? I can help you.

records.traditional: 我家的廚房很大，我常常在家做飯。
records.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de chúfáng hěn dà, wǒ chángcháng zài jiā zuòfàn.
records.english: My kitchen is quite big, I often cook at home.

records.traditional: 那家咖啡廳怎麼樣？你想再去嗎？
records.pinyin: Nà jiā kāfēitīng zěnmeyàng? Nǐ xiǎng zài qù ma?
records.english: What do you think about that café? Would you like to go again?

records.traditional: 哥哥喜歡在床上看書。
records.pinyin: Gēge xǐhuān zài chuáng shàng kànshū.
records.english: My elder brother likes to read in bed.

records.traditional: 這個新房子沒有很多家具。
records.pinyin: Zhè ge xīn fángzi méiyǒu hěn duō jiājù.
records.english: There is not much furniture in this new house.

records.traditional: 我想買一台電視機。
records.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì tái diànshìjī.
records.english: I would like to buy a television.

records.traditional: 窗戶前面有很多花，很漂亮。
records.pinyin: Chuānghù qiánmiàn yǒu hěn duō huā, hěn piàoliàng.
records.english: There are many flowers in front of the window. It’s very beautiful.

records.traditional: 弟弟在門後面。
records.pinyin: Dìdi zài mén hòumiàn.
records.english: My younger brother is behind the door.

records.traditional: 我家有一隻貓、兩隻狗和三隻鳥。
records.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī māo, liǎng zhī gǒu hé sān zhī niǎo.
records.english: I have a cat, two dogs, and three birds in my house.

records.traditional: 我的貓在房子外面曬太陽。
records.pinyin: Wǒ de māo zài fángzi wàimiàn shài tàiyáng.
records.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

records.traditional: 我跟同學常常一起在學校打網球。
records.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tóngxué chángcháng yìqǐ zài xuéxiào dǎ wǎngqiú.
records.english: My classmates and I often play tennis together at the school.

records.traditional: 我每個週末去學校打籃球。
records.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge zhōumò qù xuéxiào dǎ lánqiú.
records.english: I go to school to play basketball every weekend.

records.traditional: 我弟弟喜歡打棒球，我想送他一個棒球。
records.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi xǐhuān dǎ bàngqiú, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge bàngqiú.
records.english: My younger brother likes playing baseball, I’d like to give him a baseball as a gift.

records.traditional: 那個孩子很愛踢足球。
records.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn ài tī zúqiú.
records.english: That kid loves to play soccer very much.

records.traditional: 今天天氣不錯，我們去海邊曬太陽吧。
records.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, wǒmen qù hǎibiān shài tàiyáng ba.
records.english: The weather is nice today. Let’s go to the beach to get some sun!

records.traditional: 這個週末我們一起去看海，怎麼樣？
records.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn hǎi, zěnmeyàng?
records.english: How about going to watch the sea this weekend?

records.traditional: 你喜歡山上的風景還是海邊的風景？
records.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān shānshàng de fēngjǐng háishì hǎibiān de fēngjǐng?
records.english: Do you like the scenery on the mountain or on the beach?

records.traditional: 天氣好熱，我們去游泳，好不好？
records.pinyin: Tiānqì hǎo rè, wǒmen qù yóuyǒng, hǎo bù hǎo?
records.english: The weather is so hot. How about we go swimming?

records.traditional: 我不會游泳，你會嗎？
records.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì yóuyǒng, nǐ huì ma?
records.english: I can not swim, can you?

records.traditional: 今天我去朋友家玩得很開心。
records.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ qù péngyǒu jiā wán de hěn kāixīn.
records.english: I had fun at my friend’s place today.

records.traditional: 我每個星期都去學校跑步。
records.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge xīngqí dōu qù xuéxiào pǎobù.
records.english: I go to school to run every week.

records.traditional: 我妹妹跑得很慢。
records.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei pǎo de hěn màn.
records.english: My younger sister runs very slowly.

records.traditional: 她看書看得很快。
records.pinyin: Tā kànshū kàn de hěn kuài.
records.english: She reads very fast.

records.sourceMeaning: to say; to speak; to talk
records.traditional: 我朋友說這家餐廳的咖啡很好喝。
records.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu shuō zhè jiā cāntīng de kāfēi hěn hǎohē.
records.english: My friend said this restaurant’s coffee is good.

records.traditional: 我男朋友不太喜歡說話。
records.pinyin: Wǒ nán péngyǒu bú tài xǐhuān shuōhuà.
records.english: My boyfriend does not like to talk very much.

records.traditional: 我跟媽媽明天下午要一起去看電影。
records.pinyin: Wǒ gēn māma míngtiān xiàwǔ yào yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng.
records.english: Mom and I are going to see a movie tomorrow afternoon.

records.traditional: 我們學校旁邊有一家電影院。
records.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu yì jiā diànyǐngyuàn.
records.english: There is a movie theater next to our school.

records.traditional: 王老師的課很有趣，每個學生都喜歡她。
records.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī de kè hěn yǒuqù, měi ge xuéshēng dōu xǐhuān tā.
records.english: Teacher Wang’s class is very interesting; every student likes her.

records.traditional: 我覺得這部電影很有趣，你覺得呢？
records.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù, nǐ juéde ne?
records.english: I think this movie is very interesting. What do you think?

records.traditional: 那家店的冰淇淋很好吃，可是有點兒貴。
records.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī, kěshì yǒudiǎnr guì.
records.english: That store has delicious ice cream, but it is a bit expensive.

records.traditional: 我很累，想在房間休息。
records.pinyin: Wǒ hěn lèi, xiǎng zài fángjiān xiūxí.
records.english: I am tired; I want to take a rest in the room.

records.traditional: 我常常在咖啡廳上網、看書。
records.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng zài kāfēitīng shàngwǎng, kànshū.
records.english: I often surf the internet and read at the café.

records.traditional: 我要買一部新電腦。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yí bù xīn diànnǎo.
records.english: I want to buy a new computer.

records.traditional: 我有手機，可是沒有電腦。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shǒujī, kěshì méiyǒu diànnǎo.
records.english: I have a cell phone, but I don’t have any computer.

records.traditional: 我們應該常常說請、謝謝。
records.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi chángcháng shuō qǐng, xièxie.
records.english: We should say ‘please’, ‘thank you’ often.

records.traditional: 我每天早上七點去學校運動。
records.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qù xuéxiào yùndòng.
records.english: I go to school to exercise at 7:00 every morning.

records.traditional: 她很喜歡花，你可以送她一些漂亮的花。
records.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān huā, nǐ kěyǐ sòng tā yìxiē piàoliàng de huā.
records.english: She likes flowers very much. You can give her some beautiful flowers.

records.traditional: 這個週末我們要去騎腳踏車／自行車。
records.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒmen yào qù qí jiǎotàchē/zìxíngchē.
records.english: This weekend we are going to ride bikes.

records.traditional: 我現在不餓，只想吃一點兒水果。
records.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài bú è, zhǐ xiǎng chī yìdiǎnr shuǐguǒ.
records.english: I am not hungry now, I just want some fruit.

records.traditional: 後天是我朋友的生日，我想送他一個大蛋糕。
records.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
records.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend’s birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

records.traditional: 前天下午我在學校的圖書館看書。
records.pinyin: Qiántiān xiàwǔ wǒ zài xuéxiào de túshūguǎn kànshū.
records.english: I read at the school library in the afternoon of the day before yesterday.

records.traditional: 我的興趣是運動，打網球、游泳，我都喜歡。
records.pinyin: Wǒ de xìngqù shì yùndòng, dǎ wǎngqiú, yóuyǒng, wǒ dōu xǐhuān.
records.english: My hobby is doing exercise. I like both tennis and swimming.

records.traditional: 我有幾個臺灣朋友。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu jǐ ge Táiwān péngyǒu.
records.english: I have a few Taiwanese friends.

records.traditional: 我們都喜歡學（習）中文。
records.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu xǐhuān xué(xí) Zhōngwén.
records.english: We all like learning Chinese.

records.traditional: 他唱歌唱得很開心。
records.pinyin: Tā chànggē chàng de hěn kāixīn.
records.english: He enjoys singing very much.

records.traditional: 他會唱很多首中文歌。
records.pinyin: Tā huì chàng hěn duō shǒu Zhōngwén gē.
records.english: He can sing a lot of Chinese songs.

records.traditional: 他的舞跳得很好。
records.pinyin: Tā de wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo.
records.english: He dances very well.

records.traditional: 那個孩子很喜歡畫畫，他畫得很好。
records.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn xǐhuān huàhuà, tā huà de hěn hǎo.
records.english: That child likes painting and he draws very well.

records.traditional: 這張畫很好看，我很喜歡。
records.pinyin: Zhè zhāng huà hěn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
records.english: This painting is brilliant. I like it very much.

records.traditional: 我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
records.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
records.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

records.traditional: 我平常喜歡喝茶，有（的）時候喝一點兒咖啡。
records.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng xǐhuān hē chá, yǒu (de) shíhou hē yìdiǎnr kāfēi.
records.english: I usually like drinking tea. Sometimes I drink a little coffee.

records.traditional: 今天下午學校有籃球比賽，我們去看吧！
records.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù kàn ba!
records.english: There is a basketball game at school this afternoon. Let’s go watch it!

records.traditional: 你媽媽真漂亮！
records.pinyin: Nǐ māma zhēn piàoliàng!
records.english: Your mom is really beautiful!

records.traditional: 老師說要送我們書，我們都很高興。
records.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō yào sòng wǒmen shū, wǒmen dōu hěn gāoxìng.
records.english: The teacher said she/he is going to give us some books as gifts; we are all very happy.

records.traditional: 元真，我們明天幾點去找妳的韓國朋友？
records.simplified: 元真，我们明天几点去找妳的韩国朋友？
records.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn qù zhǎo nǐ de Hánguó péngyǒu?
records.english: Yuanzhen, what time are we going to meet up with your Korean friends tomorrow?

records.traditional: 我們下午四點要到天美飯店，她在那裡等我們。
records.simplified: 我们下午四点要到天美饭店，她在那里等我们。
records.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sì diǎn yào dào Tiānměi Fàndiàn, tā zài nàli děng wǒmen.
records.english: We have to arrive at Tianmei Hotel at 4 in the afternoon. She will wait for us there.

records.traditional: 我們要怎麼去？坐捷運還是坐公車？
records.simplified: 我们要怎么去？坐捷运还是坐公车？
records.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zěnme qù? Zuò jiéyùn háishì zuò gōngchē?
records.english: How do we get there? By MRT or bus?

records.traditional: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
records.simplified: 听说那家饭店不远，我想我们可以从学校走路去。
records.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
records.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

records.traditional: 可是我不知道怎麼走，妳知道嗎？
records.simplified: 可是我不知道怎么走，妳知道吗？
records.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme zǒu, nǐ zhīdào ma?
records.english: But I don’t know how to get there, do you?

records.traditional: 我也不知道。我們可以先上網看地圖。
records.simplified: 我也不知道。我们可以先上网看地图。
records.pinyin: Wǒ yě bù zhīdào. Wǒmen kěyǐ xiān shàngwǎng kàn dìtú.
records.english: I don’t know either. We can check the map online first.

records.traditional: 啊！上課了！我們先上課吧。
records.simplified: 啊！上课了！我们先上课吧。
records.pinyin: A! Shàngkè le! Wǒmen xiān shàngkè ba.
records.english: Ah! The class has started! Let’s go to class now.

records.traditional: 好。
records.simplified: 好。
records.pinyin: Hǎo.
records.english: Okay.

records.traditional: 友美，妳看，天美飯店在大學路。我現在知道怎麼走了。
records.simplified: 友美，妳看，天美饭店在大学路。我现在知道怎么走了。
records.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ kàn, Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài Dàxué Lù. Wǒ xiànzài zhīdào zěnme zǒu le.
records.english: Look, Youmei. Tianmei Hotel is on Daxue Road. Now I know how to get there.

records.traditional: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
records.simplified: （看地图）啊！天美饭店在这里！我知道这个地方，附近有邮局跟超级市场。
records.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
records.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

records.traditional: 我想走路去一定沒問題。
records.simplified: 我想走路去一定没问题。
records.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zǒulù qù yídìng méi wèntí.
records.english: I think it will certainly be okay going there on foot.

records.traditional: 可是我覺得那裡有點兒遠，走路去太累了。
records.simplified: 可是我觉得那里有点儿远，走路去太累了。
records.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde nàlǐ yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, zǒulù qù tài lèi le.
records.english: But I think it’s a bit far. It’s too tiring to get there on foot.

records.traditional: 妳想怎麼去？
records.simplified: 妳想怎么去？
records.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zěnme qù?
records.english: How do you want to get there?

records.traditional: 坐捷運又方便又舒服，我們可以坐捷運。
records.simplified: 坐捷运又方便又舒服，我们可以坐捷运。
records.pinyin: Zuò jiéyùn yòu fāngbiàn yòu shūfu, wǒmen kěyǐ zuò jiéyùn.
records.english: Taking the MRT is convenient and comfortable. We can take the MRT.

records.traditional: 好，我們明天坐捷運去吧。
records.simplified: 好，我们明天坐捷运去吧。
records.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen míngtiān zuò jiéyùn qù ba.
records.english: Ok, let’s take the MRT to get there tomorrow.

records.traditional: 我家附近有三條捷運線，一條紅的、一條綠的和一條藍的。
records.simplified: 我家附近有三条捷运线，一条红的、一条绿的和一条蓝的。
records.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu sān tiáo jiéyùn xiàn, yì tiáo hóng de, yì tiáo lǜ de hé yì tiáo lán de.
records.english: There are three MRT routes near my place; the red one, the green one and the blue one.

records.traditional: 我平常坐紅線去學校上課，週末也坐捷運去運動、看電影。
records.simplified: 我平常坐红线去学校上课，周末也坐捷运去运动、看电影。
records.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zuò hóng xiàn qù xuéxiào shàngkè, zhōumò yě zuò jiéyùn qù yùndòng, kàn diànyǐng.
records.english: I usually go to school by the red one. On weekends I take it to exercise or see a movie as well.

records.traditional: 朋友常來找我，他們都覺得坐捷運來我家，又快又方便。
records.simplified: 朋友常来找我，他们都觉得坐捷运来我家，又快又方便。
records.pinyin: Péngyǒu cháng lái zhǎo wǒ, tāmen dōu juéde zuò jiéyùn lái wǒ jiā, yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn.
records.english: My friends often visit me. They all think taking the MRT to my house is both fast and convenient.

records.traditional: 從我家到機場也不遠，開車去、坐捷運去都可以。
records.simplified: 从我家到机场也不远，开车去、坐捷运去都可以。
records.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào jīchǎng yě bù yuǎn, kāichē qù, zuò jiéyùn qù dōu kěyǐ.
records.english: It is not far from my house to the airport. I can go by car or MRT.

records.traditional: 機場附近的風景也很漂亮，我常常去看風景、看飛機。
records.simplified: 机场附近的风景也很漂亮，我常常去看风景、看飞机。
records.pinyin: Jīchǎng fùjìn de fēngjǐng yě hěn piàoliang, wǒ chángcháng qù kàn fēngjǐng, kàn fēijī.
records.english: The scenery near the airport is beautiful; I often go there to see the view and watch the planes.

records.traditional: 元真，妳的這條裙子真好看，我很喜歡。
records.simplified: 元真，妳的这条裙子真好看，我很喜欢。
records.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, nǐ de zhè tiáo qúnzi zhēn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
records.english: Yuanzhen, your skirt is very beautiful; I like it very much.

records.traditional: 謝謝，這是我去年的生日禮物。
records.simplified: 谢谢，这是我去年的生日礼物。
records.pinyin: Xièxie, zhè shì wǒ qùnián de shēngrì lǐwù.
records.english: Thanks, this is my birthday gift from last year.

records.traditional: 聽說這個牌子的東西很貴，可是很多人喜歡。
records.simplified: 听说这个牌子的东西很贵，可是很多人喜欢。
records.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè ge páizi de dōngxi hěn guì, kěshì hěn duō rén xǐhuān.
records.english: I heard that this clothing brand is very expensive, but a lot of people like it.

records.traditional: 是啊，因為這個牌子很有名，衣服、褲子和裙子也都很好看，所以很多人買。
records.simplified: 是啊，因为这个牌子很有名，衣服、裤子和裙子也都很好看，所以很多人买。
records.pinyin: Shì a, yīnwèi zhè ge páizi hěn yǒumíng, yīfu, kùzi hé qúnzi yě dōu hěn hǎokàn, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén mǎi.
records.english: Yes, it is. This brand is very famous and its tops, pants and skirts are very beautiful, so many people buy it.

records.traditional: 妳知道去哪裡買這個牌子的衣服嗎？
records.simplified: 妳知道去哪里买这个牌子的衣服吗？
records.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào qù nǎlǐ mǎi zhè ge páizi de yīfu ma?
records.english: Do you know where you can get this clothing brand?

records.traditional: 知道，百貨公司都有，不難找。
records.simplified: 知道，百货公司都有，不难找。
records.pinyin: Zhīdào, bǎihuògōngsī dōu yǒu, bù nán zhǎo.
records.english: Yes. I think you can get them in department stores; it is not too difficult to find.

records.traditional: 我很想去看，可是我最近胖了五公斤，我怕衣服不好買。
records.simplified: 我很想去看，可是我最近胖了五公斤，我怕衣服不好买。
records.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù kàn, kěshì wǒ zuìjìn pàng le wǔ gōngjīn, wǒ pà yīfu bù hǎo mǎi.
records.english: I would like to check it out. But I have recently gained 5 kilograms, so I am worried that they don’t have my size.

records.traditional: 妳胖了嗎？我不覺得啊，我跟妳一起去看。我也想去買今年夏天的新衣服。
records.simplified: 妳胖了吗？我不觉得啊，我跟妳一起去看。我也想去买今年夏天的新衣服。
records.pinyin: Nǐ pàng le ma? Wǒ bù juéde a, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù kàn. Wǒ yě xiǎng qù mǎi jīnnián xiàtiān de xīn yīfu.
records.english: Have you gained weight? I don’t think so. I can go check with you. I would like to buy the new summer collections.

records.traditional: 好，我們找時間一起去。
records.simplified: 好，我们找时间一起去。
records.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen zhǎo shíjiān yìqǐ qù.
records.english: Okay, let’s make time for it.

records.traditional: 妳看，這條黃色的褲子不錯吧？
records.simplified: 妳看，这条黄色的裤子不错吧？
records.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè tiáo huángsè de kùzi búcuò ba?
records.english: Look! This pair of yellow pants is nice, isn’t it?

records.traditional: 很好看。這條藍的也很漂亮，藍色是今年很流行的顏色。
records.simplified: 很好看。这条蓝的也很漂亮，蓝色是今年很流行的颜色。
records.pinyin: Hěn hǎokàn. Zhè tiáo lán de yě hěn piàoliang, lánsè shì jīnnián hěn liúxíng de yánsè.
records.english: It is. This pair of blue pants is beautiful too. Blue is a popular color of this year.

records.traditional: 這兩條我都去穿穿看。
records.simplified: 这两条我都去穿穿看。
records.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiáo wǒ dōu qù chuānchuān kàn.
records.english: I will try both on.

records.traditional: 妳覺得怎麼樣？
records.simplified: 妳觉得怎么样？
records.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng?
records.english: What do you think?

records.traditional: 都太短，也太小了。
records.simplified: 都太短，也太小了。
records.pinyin: Dōu tài duǎn, yě tài xiǎo le.
records.english: They are both too short and too small.

records.traditional: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
records.simplified: 没关系，我们可以下个周末再来看。对了，妳要买鞋子吧？
records.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
records.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

records.traditional: 是啊，我想買一雙黑色的。
records.simplified: 是啊，我想买一双黑色的。
records.pinyin: Shì a, wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì shuāng hēisè de.
records.english: Yes, I would like to buy a pair of black ones.

records.traditional: 鞋子都在一樓，我們到樓下去吧！九點了，百貨公司快要關了。
records.simplified: 鞋子都在一楼，我们到楼下去吧！九点了，百货公司快要关了。
records.pinyin: Xiézi dōu zài yì lóu, wǒmen dào lóuxià qù ba! Jiǔ diǎn le, bǎihuògōngsī kuàiyào guān le.
records.english: All the shoes are on the first floor. Let’s go downstairs. It’s 9:00; the department store is closing soon.

records.traditional: 電梯在那裡！我們現在去買。
records.simplified: 电梯在那里！我们现在去买。
records.pinyin: Diàntī zài nàlǐ! Wǒmen xiànzài qù mǎi.
records.english: There is the elevator! Let’s go get them now.

records.traditional: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
records.simplified: 百货公司里有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年轻女生喜欢到百货公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她们都想穿穿看。
records.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
records.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

records.traditional: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
records.simplified: 很多年轻男生爱在书店看汽车杂志，汽车很贵，他们不一定可以买新车，可是都看得很开心。
records.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
records.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

records.traditional: 我覺得有的舊東西很不錯，有的新東西也很有趣，我很喜歡看新車、新衣服，可是因為我的錢不多，所以我不常買。
records.simplified: 我觉得有的旧东西很不错，有的新东西也很有趣，我很喜欢看新车、新衣服，可是因为我的钱不多，所以我不常买。
records.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒude jiù dōngxi hěn búcuò, yǒude xīn dōngxi yě hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xīn chē, xīn yīfu, kěshì yīnwèi wǒ de qián bù duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng mǎi.
records.english: I think some old stuff is good and some new ones are interesting. I like to check the new car, new clothes out, but I do not have much money, so I don’t buy them often.

records.traditional: 友美，這幾個句子的意思我不太懂，妳可以教我嗎？
records.simplified: 友美，这几个句子的意思我不太懂，妳可以教我吗？
records.pinyin: Yǒuměi, zhè jǐ ge jùzi de yìsi wǒ bú tài dǒng, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
records.english: Youmei, I don’t quite understand these sentences. Could you teach me?

records.traditional: 我覺得有點兒難，我也不太懂。
records.simplified: 我觉得有点儿难，我也不太懂。
records.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒudiǎnr nán, wǒ yě bú tài dǒng.
records.english: It is a little bit difficult; I don’t quite understand them, either.

records.traditional: 這課真的不好學。
records.simplified: 这课真的不好学。
records.pinyin: Zhè kè zhēnde bù hǎo xué.
records.english: This chapter is really difficult to learn.

records.traditional: 我們可以去問家樂，他非常聰明，我想他懂。
records.simplified: 我们可以去问家乐，他非常聪明，我想他懂。
records.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ qù wèn Jiālè, tā fēicháng cōngmíng, wǒ xiǎng tā dǒng.
records.english: We can ask Jiale; he is very smart. I think he understands it.

records.traditional: 那麼我們現在去找他。
records.simplified: 那么我们现在去找他。
records.pinyin: Nàme wǒmen xiànzài qù zhǎo tā.
records.english: Let’s go ask him now.

records.traditional: 現在他在上書法課，我們四點去吧。
records.simplified: 现在他在上书法课，我们四点去吧。
records.pinyin: Xiànzài tā zài shàng shūfǎ kè, wǒmen sì diǎn qù ba.
records.english: He is in the calligraphy class now. Let’s do it at 4 p.m.

records.traditional: 可是從四點到五點半我要上英文課，六點去，怎麼樣？
records.simplified: 可是从四点到五点半我要上英文课，六点去，怎么样？
records.pinyin: Kěshì cóng sì diǎn dào wǔ diǎn bàn wǒ yào shàng Yīngwén kè, liù diǎn qù, zěnmeyàng?
records.english: But I have an English class from 4 to 5:30 p.m. How about 6 p.m.?

records.traditional: 好。我先回宿舍做功課，再跟你一起去找他。
records.simplified: 好。我先回宿舍做功课，再跟你一起去找他。
records.pinyin: Hǎo. Wǒ xiān huí sùshè zuò gōngkè, zài gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù zhǎo tā.
records.english: Okay. I will go back to the dormitory to do my homework first, then I will go to see him with you.

records.traditional: 期中考快要到了，老師說我們可以去圖書館對面的大教室看書。
records.simplified: 期中考快要到了，老师说我们可以去图书馆对面的大教室看书。
records.pinyin: Qízhōngkǎo kuàiyào dào le, lǎoshī shuō wǒmen kěyǐ qù túshūguǎn duìmiàn de dà jiàoshì kànshū.
records.english: The midterm exam is coming soon. The teacher said we could use the big classroom across from the library for studying.

records.traditional: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
records.simplified: 太好了！在那里看书很舒服。我们每天都能用那间教室吗？
records.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
records.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

records.traditional: 我們班只能禮拜一跟禮拜二下午用。
records.simplified: 我们班只能礼拜一跟礼拜二下午用。
records.pinyin: Wǒmen bān zhǐ néng lǐbài yī gēn lǐbài èr xiàwǔ yòng.
records.english: Our class can only use it in the afternoon on Mondays and Tuesdays.

records.traditional: 可是這些時間我都有語言交換，不能去。
records.simplified: 可是这些时间我都有语言交换，不能去。
records.pinyin: Kěshì zhèxiē shíjiān wǒ dōu yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, bù néng qù.
records.english: But I will be doing language exchange during that time. I can’t make it.

records.traditional: 別的時間可以嗎？
records.simplified: 别的时间可以吗？
records.pinyin: Biéde shíjiān kěyǐ ma?
records.english: Can you swap the time?

records.traditional: 我朋友最近比較忙，別的時間他沒有空。
records.simplified: 我朋友最近比较忙，别的时间他没有空。
records.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu zuìjìn bǐjiào máng, biéde shíjiān tā méi yǒukòng.
records.english: My friend is busier lately; he isn’t available at other times.

records.traditional: 我們去問老師，也許他可以幫你。
records.simplified: 我们去问老师，也许他可以帮你。
records.pinyin: Wǒmen qù wèn lǎoshī, yěxǔ tā kěyǐ bāng nǐ.
records.english: Let’s ask the teacher; maybe he can help you.

records.traditional: 好，希望老師可以幫我。
records.simplified: 好，希望老师可以帮我。
records.pinyin: Hǎo, xīwàng lǎoshī kěyǐ bāng wǒ.
records.english: Okay, I hope the teacher has some good ideas.

records.traditional: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
records.simplified: 这个学期开始，从星期一到星期五我都有华语课，每天从上午八点四十分到中午十二点上课，下午一点写功课，有时候也跟同学练习说中文。
records.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
records.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

records.traditional: 最近我的台灣朋友想學日文，請我教他，我也請他教我中文。
records.simplified: 最近我的台湾朋友想学日文，请我教他，我也请他教我中文。
records.pinyin: Zuìjìn wǒ de Táiwān péngyǒu xiǎng xué Rìwén, qǐng wǒ jiāo tā, wǒ yě qǐng tā jiāo wǒ Zhōngwén.
records.english: These days, one of my Taiwanese friends wants to learn Japanese. He asked me to teach him Japanese, so I asked him to teach me Chinese as well.

records.traditional: 現在我非常忙，沒有很多時間讀書，可是因為有語言交換，所以我的中文進步了。
records.simplified: 现在我非常忙，没有很多时间读书，可是因为有语言交换，所以我的中文进步了。
records.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ fēicháng máng, méi yǒu hěn duō shíjiān dúshū, kěshì yīnwèi yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, suǒyǐ wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le.
records.english: Nowadays, I am very busy; I don’t have much time for studying. However, because of language exchange, I have improved (my Chinese) a lot.

records.traditional: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
records.simplified: 下个星期华语课有期中考，我有一点儿紧张，所以每天晚上都读书，也练习写字，希望下个星期的考试能考得很好。
records.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
records.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

records.traditional: 老師，國安今天要請假。他發燒了，不能來上課。
records.simplified: 老师，国安今天要请假。他发烧了，不能来上课。
records.pinyin: Lǎoshī, Guó'ān jīntiān yào qǐngjià. Tā fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè.
records.english: Teacher, Guoan has to take a leave today. He has a fever and he can’t come to school.

records.traditional: 他發燒了？那他應該去看醫生。
records.simplified: 他发烧了？那他应该去看医生。
records.pinyin: Tā fāshāo le? Nà tā yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
records.english: He has a fever? He should see a doctor then.

records.traditional: 國安跟我說，他今天要去看醫生，他家附近有一家不錯的醫院。
records.simplified: 国安跟我说，他今天要去看医生，他家附近有一家不错的医院。
records.pinyin: Guó'ān gēn wǒ shuō, tā jīntiān yào qù kàn yīshēng, tā jiā fùjìn yǒu yì jiā búcuò de yīyuàn.
records.english: Guoan told me he is going to see a doctor today; there is a nice hospital near his place.

records.traditional: 最近很多人感冒，你們要戴口罩，也要常常洗手。
records.simplified: 最近很多人感冒，你们要戴口罩，也要常常洗手。
records.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào, nǐmen yào dài kǒuzhào, yě yào chángcháng xǐshǒu.
records.english: Many people got sick lately. You need to wear a surgical mask and wash your hands often.

records.traditional: 老師，我很健康，不常生病。
records.simplified: 老师，我很健康，不常生病。
records.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒ hěn jiànkāng, bù cháng shēngbìng.
records.english: I am healthy and seldom get sick, teacher.

records.traditional: 平常不生病的人也要注意。
records.simplified: 平常不生病的人也要注意。
records.pinyin: Píngcháng bù shēngbìng de rén yě yào zhùyì.
records.english: People who don’t get sick often should pay attention to their health as well.

records.traditional: 對，我應該多注意身體健康。
records.simplified: 对，我应该多注意身体健康。
records.pinyin: Duì, wǒ yīnggāi duō zhùyì shēntǐ jiànkāng.
records.english: You are right. I should pay more attention to it.

records.traditional: 妳可以帶一些水果去看國安，跟他說應該多喝水，也要多休息。
records.simplified: 妳可以带一些水果去看国安，跟他说应该多喝水，也要多休息。
records.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn Guó'ān, gēn tā shuō yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, yě yào duō xiūxí.
records.english: You can take some fruit to visit Guoan. Tell him to drink plenty of water and get much rest as well.

records.traditional: 好，我明天帶一些蘋果去看他。
records.simplified: 好，我明天带一些苹果去看他。
records.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ míngtiān dài yìxiē píngguǒ qù kàn tā.
records.english: Okay. I will take some apples to see him tomorrow.

records.traditional: 你覺得哪裡不舒服？
records.simplified: 你觉得哪里不舒服？
records.pinyin: Nǐ juéde nǎlǐ bù shūfu?
records.english: Where are you uncomfortable? (What brings you here today?)

records.traditional: 我咳嗽、頭痛，鼻子也不舒服。
records.simplified: 我咳嗽、头痛，鼻子也不舒服。
records.pinyin: Wǒ késou, tóu tòng, bízi yě bù shūfu.
records.english: I have a cough and headache. Also my nose is uncomfortable.

records.traditional: 最近天氣冷了，很多人感冒了。
records.simplified: 最近天气冷了，很多人感冒了。
records.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì lěng le, hěn duō rén gǎnmào le.
records.english: The weather is getting cold recently, many people got colds.

records.traditional: 對啊！聽說我們學校感冒、發燒的學生很多。
records.simplified: 对啊！听说我们学校感冒、发烧的学生很多。
records.pinyin: Duì a! Tīngshuō wǒmen xuéxiào gǎnmào, fāshāo de xuéshēng hěn duō.
records.english: Right! I heard that many students from my school have a cold and fever.

records.traditional: 最近也有很多人肚子痛。
records.simplified: 最近也有很多人肚子痛。
records.pinyin: Zuìjìn yě yǒu hěn duō rén dùzi tòng.
records.english: Many people have a stomachache as well.

records.traditional: 是因為吃的東西不乾淨嗎？
records.simplified: 是因为吃的东西不干净吗？
records.pinyin: Shì yīnwèi chī de dōngxi bù gānjìng ma?
records.english: Is it because of having contaminated food?

records.traditional: 不是，這也是因為感冒。
records.simplified: 不是，这也是因为感冒。
records.pinyin: Bú shì, zhè yě shì yīnwèi gǎnmào.
records.english: No, it is also due to having a cold.

records.traditional: 請問我需要吃藥嗎？
records.simplified: 请问我需要吃药吗？
records.pinyin: Qǐngwèn wǒ xūyào chī yào ma?
records.english: Do I have to take any medicine?

records.traditional: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
records.simplified: 我会给你三天的药。你要记得多喝一点儿水，要是发烧了，就吃红色的药。
records.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
records.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

records.traditional: 好，謝謝醫生。
records.simplified: 好，谢谢医生。
records.pinyin: Hǎo, xièxie yīshēng.
records.english: Okay, Thank you doctor.

records.traditional: 最近感冒的人很多，我的同學國安也感冒了，今天開始發燒了。
records.simplified: 最近感冒的人很多，我的同学国安也感冒了，今天开始发烧了。
records.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, wǒ de tóngxué Guó'ān yě gǎnmào le, jīntiān kāishǐ fāshāo le.
records.english: Many people got colds lately. My classmate, Guoan, got a cold, too. He started to have a fever today.

records.traditional: 他打電話跟我說，他不能來上課，請我幫他請假。
records.simplified: 他打电话跟我说，他不能来上课，请我帮他请假。
records.pinyin: Tā dǎ diànhuà gēn wǒ shuō, tā bù néng lái shàngkè, qǐng wǒ bāng tā qǐngjià.
records.english: He gave me a call and told me that he couldn’t make it to class and asked me to ask for a leave for him.

records.traditional: 我很擔心他，請他去看醫生，也告訴他要聽醫生的話，不要忘記多喝水、多休息。
records.simplified: 我很担心他，请他去看医生，也告诉他要听医生的话，不要忘记多喝水、多休息。
records.pinyin: Wǒ hěn dānxīn tā, qǐng tā qù kàn yīshēng, yě gàosu tā yào tīng yīshēng de huà, bú yào wàngjì duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí.
records.english: I’m so worried about him, so I told him to go see a doctor. I also told him to listen to the doctor, to drink plenty of water and get some rest.

records.traditional: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
records.simplified: 他说他会去看医生，请我们不要担心，如果他好了，就会来学校上课。
records.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
records.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

records.traditional: 今天我要帶一些水果去看他，也會跟他說今天的功課。
records.simplified: 今天我要带一些水果去看他，也会跟他说今天的功课。
records.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ yào dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn tā, yě huì gēn tā shuō jīntiān de gōngkè.
records.english: Today, I am going to take some fruit to visit him and also inform him about the homework today.

records.traditional: 我們都希望他明天能回學校上課。
records.simplified: 我们都希望他明天能回学校上课。
records.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu xīwàng tā míngtiān néng huí xuéxiào shàngkè.
records.english: We all hope he can come back to school tomorrow.
